quality_rules_applied: Unknown builder lower and upper bounds remain null, never zero from profile silence.
An industrial-engineering degree or non-software job is not proof a person cannot build software.
A company-size range and visible employees are neither complete engineering headcount nor a maximum.
People who like a post are not its authors or founders; infer neither identity nor demand from reactions.
Current programs may admit existing products. Exact edition, original intent, product stage and complete team are separate gates.
Observed relative timestamps are not converted into publication dates; search crawl dates are not post dates.
A functional app or beta fails the unbuilt core-product target even if its founder is alone.
A solo technical founder is not automatically excluded if the app remains unbuilt and all other gates pass.
Admissions, prizes, investor interest and co-founder searches do not establish budget or paid vendor demand.
No canonical files, outreach, contact enrichment, follows, connections, messages or social reactions were performed.
